en: A black-and-white photograph showing a large group of men in uniform posed in several rows in front of a large, multi-story European-style building. The uniforms suggest they are military cadets or soldiers, with a few higher-ranking officers seated in the front row. The setting appears formal and official, likely outside a military academy or barracks. There is no visible text on the front of the image.
